goal: Establish a project-wide error handling strategy for Bitcoin Core.
Avoid recurring ad-hoc debates over error propagation across validation and subsystem refactors.
reviewability: Ready for review as the proposal is complete and technical debate on the design is active.
agreement: Concept approval for defining a centralized error handling strategy (josibake, willcl-ark, sedited)
Unaddressed objection: contradicts existing codebase patterns and adds technical debt (ajtowns)
Approach objection: exceptions introduce invisible non-local control flow and side effects (l0rinc)
Safety objection: abrupt defect aborts endanger wallet state and harm P2P resilience (furszy, mzumsande)
Approach objection: risks shutdown deadlocks and increases review cognitive load (maflcko)

categories.name: docs
why: P2 because it defines project-wide architectural guidelines for error handling across all subsystems.
Provides high leverage by unblocking recurring design debates in ongoing validation and P2P refactors.
